biotools.summary: The Zarr specification defines a format for chunked, compressed, N-dimensional arrays.  It's design allows efficient access to subsets of the stored array, and supports both local and cloud storage systems.  Rarr aims to implement this specification in R with minimal reliance on an external tools or libraries.
